app.name: Backdoor_025ab95fa2b88dab_Android14
app.description: Android app under backdoor detection analysis by EchoDroid

backdoor_verdict.verdict_explanation: High-confidence UI-vs-backend mismatch indicating hidden malicious behaviour.

backdoor_patterns.explanation: The app claims to be a theme installer/customizer and provides no UI indication or justification for SMS access. However, it registers background receivers for SMS and MMS and actively retrieves SMSC information in a background service. These actions are performed without user knowledge or interaction, indicating covert SMS interception and manipulation capabilities.

The backend collects SMSC (Short Message Service Center) information, which is highly sensitive and rarely required by legitimate apps. This is a common tactic in SMS interception or redirection malware. There is no UI disclosure or user-facing justification for this data collection.
Sensitive SMS-handling services are exported, allowing external apps or attackers to trigger SMS-related functionality without user interaction. This creates a hidden entry point for abuse.

sms.notes: Sensitive SMS/MMS receiver and SMSC retrieval are implemented in a Service, not an Activity. This indicates backend/background SMS handling, likely without user interaction.

suspicious_methods.reason: Directly accesses SMSC (Short Message Service Center) information, which is rarely needed by legitimate apps and is a common tactic for SMS interception or manipulation.

stealthy_patterns_found: Background SMS/MMS interception via Service receivers (not user-facing Activity).

recommendations: Immediately remove this app from any device or app store due to covert SMS interception and manipulation.
Alert users and security teams to the presence of exported, sensitive services that can be abused remotely.
Perform a full forensic review of devices where this app was installed to check for evidence of SMS exfiltration or abuse.
Blocklist the package name and related signatures in enterprise and consumer security solutions.
prompt3_backdoor_detection.analyst_notes: This app demonstrates classic backdoor behavior: it claims to be a harmless theme installer but covertly registers background SMS/MMS receivers and retrieves SMSC information, all without any UI disclosure or user consent. The presence of exported services handling SMS further increases the risk of remote exploitation. These patterns are highly indicative of malware designed for SMS interception, manipulation, or exfiltration.
